set.pl: East side of Main St between Third and Fourth Sts, Racine: the site the Knights of Columbus bought in Nov 1922 for their planned home (Racine Journal-News, 11 Dec 1922); the 1928 hall at Fifth and College was a later site

set.t: Downtown block on S. Main St, built over: look only.

tw-wi-racine-baker-cellar-hoard-1922.st: The December 1922 plans placed the new clubhouse on the east side of Main Street between Third and Fourth, so the old house stood on that block; the hall dedicated in 1928 at Fifth and College was a different site. Whether the Main Street house was razed and its cellar dug is not reported.
